remarks: Every detail of this impeccably maintained townhouse has been thoughtfully curated for style, comfort, and convenience. The kitchen is a true showpiece, boasting gleaming granite countertops, a granite and shiplap backsplash, stainless steel appliances, a gas cooktop and oven, and porcelain tile flooring. Updated lighting and a statement chandelier illuminate the space, while a custom upholstered built-in bench adds charm and functionality. Sophisticated chandeliers, updated lighting, and designer window treatments flow seamlessly throughout the home. The inviting living room features a cozy wood-burning fireplace-perfect for relaxing evenings or entertaining guests. The primary suite offers a serene retreat with a luxurious en-suite bath featuring fog-free heated and LED lighted mirrors. A spacious second bedroom with its own private bath provides the perfect setup for guests or family. Each bathroom features a new remote-controlled skylight with built-in shade. The finished basement offers abundant versatility-ideal for a home office, fitness area, or media room-expanding your living and entertaining space, with additional abundant storage space...
